description:
Implement the missing Web/WebWidget capability declarations so the existing BO Advanced settings and file-limit validation consume real Web facts, just as they already consume SMTP metadata. User requested this follow-up on 2026-11-26. This is the Web-specific slice of zaq-h2i.4, not authorization to change Jido/Mattermost.

Verified starting point: feat/channel-file-settings at bfb3e677c. WebBridge.capability_snapshot/1 declares text/streaming/typing/edit_messages but no file_delivery metadata. EmailBridge supplies typed file_delivery.limits. Web Widget BO already renders the shared file settings component in Advanced; do not create a second UI or validator. Reverify live source and PR_STACK.md before choosing the implementation worktree/base.

Implementation instructions:
1. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/services/channels.md, docs/services/engine.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable code-quality/naming policies. Read DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md only if UI changes are actually needed.
2. Audit native Web and configured WebWidget separately: inspect Web.Delivery and the selected adapter's existing declaration seam and actual delivery behavior. Record declaration ownership and reuse/extend evidence. Reuse existing owners; do not introduce a synthetic adapter, parallel normalizer, new module/framework, Action or endpoint just for metadata.
3. Expose truthful, pure selected-configuration declarations through existing WebBridge.capability_snapshot/1. Use an existing adapter declaration API where available; native Web has no configured adapter, so its existing delivery owner is the candidate source. Do not copy SMTP/Mattermost constraints, invent limits, perform network discovery on Save, or claim file support merely because settings metadata exists. Missing facts remain unresolved; not_applicable and unsupported retain their meanings. Configured overrides must not masquerade as independent transport ceilings.
4. Keep generic normalization in CommunicationBridge and existing FileSettings metadata/validation helpers. Preserve the existing snapshot envelope and status-only capability terminology. Declare applicable file_delivery facts and limits with value/configurable/required/type/unit/allowlisted validation, using the established contract. Distinguish native Web from WebWidget whenever their real transport facts differ.
5. Reuse the already wired BO Advanced component, proposal-snapshot validation, Ecto changesets and grouped transaction/error projection. Required/positive/bounds validation applies only when the feature is usable. Do not break unsupported-feature empty saves, drafts, selected-connection isolation or final-state policy validation. No separate Web-specific validation algorithm.
6. External adapter work is not implicitly authorized here: no Jido/Mattermost changes, dependency pin changes, ignored deps edits or local overrides. If installed WebWidget lacks a needed source API, record the exact external prerequisite under the parent issue and complete independent native-Web work; do not silently replace missing facts with hardcoded support.

Acceptance and validation:
- Production Web declarations, not only a fake test bridge, flow through the shared normalized snapshot to existing Advanced settings and save validation.
- Document the verified difference between native Web and WebWidget and any externally blocked subset; do not label an unresolved subset complete.
- Add focused producer/normalization and BO/persistence tests proving truthful support, typed metadata, unresolved and inapplicable behavior, selected-config isolation, blank/whitespace required rejection when usable, valid saves, and rollback on invalid final configuration. Reuse existing test suites and fixtures; preserve SMTP assertions. Obtain explicit approval before modifying existing test behavior under the repository gate.
- Run issue-scoped tests and mix q; follow existing human UX/new-E2E, coverage and final precommit gates without duplicating their tracking issues. Update existing owner docs only as needed. No commit, push or publication is authorized by this issue creation.
title: Expose Web file capability declarations to shared Advanced settings
